unlisted_practices: Conduct prospective testing and validation of AI tools in their intended setting before and during clinical implementation.
Evaluate AI performance across population subgroups to detect worse outcomes for underrepresented groups.
Study how AI interacts with human users in healthcare contexts, including how it changes clinical decision-making behavior.
Evaluate AI tools on actual benefit and potential harm to individuals and populations, not solely on operational measures such as productivity.
Consider feasibility of AI implementation in resource-limited settings where it is most needed when designing studies.

screen.reason: Title indicates a commentary or perspective article discussing strategies and recommendations for supporting the transition to AI in healthcare.
